prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic raw 35mm-film portrait of an adult woman with long voluminous dark-brown hair in a loose blowout with deep side part, soft glamour makeup, defined brows, rosy cheeks and glossy nude-pink lips. She stands in three-quarter view leaning slightly against a stone balcony railing, holding a silver-and-black filigree Venetian masquerade mask near her face. She wears a form-fitting silver sequin midi dress with spaghetti straps, a thin silver diamond tennis necklace and a thin bangle. Set the scene outdoors at night with dark sky, vague architectural silhouettes and low-light urban ambience. Use direct camera flash, hard contrast, realistic shadow behind subject, visible skin pores, realistic hair strands, sharp eyes and high-fidelity sequin texture. Keep the fashion context adult and editorial.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, distorted mask, broken jewelry, transparent clothing
